name: morph-surface
title: Morph Surface
description: A small pill that morphs into a feedback form and back, with a shared dot and a check on success.

props.name: triggerLabel
props.description: Text of the pill's trigger and the heading above the field when open.

props.name: triggerIcon
props.description: Icon shown before the trigger label.

props.name: title
props.description: Name shown beside the dot in the collapsed pill.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called with the form data on submit. The surface closes and shows a check once it resolves.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called when the surface closes without sending.

props.name: isOpen
props.description: Controlled open state. Leave it out to let the surface manage itself.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the next open state.

props.name: collapsedWidth
props.description: Width of the collapsed pill in pixels.

props.name: expandedWidth
props.description: Width of the open surface in pixels.

props.name: expandedHeight
props.description: Height of the open surface in pixels.
